evidence.observed: A fresh tool read returned the stated page data.
evidence.readbackVerified: A fresh post-action observation confirms the stated business condition.
evidence.historical: A dated past case; it is not a current page or account fact.
evidence.unverified: A hypothesis, unavailable check, or tool outcome without business readback.

coverage.bounded: Only the returned items, page segment, and fields are covered.
coverage.complete: Requires explicit traversal/end, count or deduplication evidence, and required-field coverage.

stateVocabulary.unknown: Preserve absence of evidence as unknown; do not convert it to false, empty, unavailable, or impossible.

actionTemplates.goal: Enter the intended SBC group from the SBC list.
preconditions: A fresh card/control reference whose context matches groupTitle
The selected control is distinguishable from favourite/save or other adjacent actions
actionTemplates.locate: Use the current semantic card context and the group title. Do not reuse selectors, element IDs, document IDs, snapshots, or a prior tab identity.
actionTemplates.expectedEffect: The group detail surface becomes available for observation.
actionTemplates.readback: Read the resulting page and confirm the intended group title plus challenge entries or an equivalent group-detail marker.
actionTemplates.recovery: If outcome is unknown, query the original request in the same channel. If the target is busy, recover the earlier unresolved request before any new write. If detail cannot be distinguished from favourite/save, stop and refine the generic locator.
actionTemplates.verificationStatus: unverified: this action did not reach the stated real-page readback in the 2026-09-26 session.

actionTemplates.goal: Open one challenge for inspection without assuming it is complete or editable.
preconditions: Fresh target reference in the intended group
actionTemplates.locate: Match challenge title in the fresh group observation and inspect the target's card context.
actionTemplates.expectedEffect: A challenge detail surface is available.
actionTemplates.readback: Confirm challenge title and read any currently exposed rules, formation, reward, and completion marker. Missing fields remain unknown.
actionTemplates.recovery: Use the request-status rule for unknown outcomes; otherwise obtain a new group observation and locate again.
actionTemplates.verificationStatus: unverified: this action did not reach the stated real-page readback in the 2026-09-26 session.

taskPatterns.input: A user goal that identifies an FC task instance by current visible title or supplied criteria.
taskPatterns.completion: The Agent reports only fields read from the current instance with their coverage; no account-changing action is required.
steps: Discover a fresh page and identify its page state
Navigate using a matching action template and verify the business readback
Read rules, object instances, and constraints with explicit bounded/complete/unknown coverage

taskPatterns.input: A current challenge instance and an authorized request to prepare, not submit, a candidate.
taskPatterns.completion: Each proposed instance assignment, rule check, and search limitation is stated from current evidence.
steps: Read current challenge requirements and available card-instance attributes
Use deterministic local computation only on observed inputs
Keep incomplete inventory coverage separate from candidate feasibility and from any no-solution claim

taskPatterns.input: A fresh target, current user authorization for the specific account effect, and a task-specific completion condition.
taskPatterns.completion: A fresh business readback confirms the intended effect and reports any observed instance/completion change.
steps: Reconfirm target and preconditions from a fresh observation
Recover unknown outcomes before another write
Read back the business effect; record any remaining unknowns

beforeAction: Record expected effect, preconditions, source, observation time, and bounded scope
afterAction: Record tool outcome and fresh business readback
Promote a rule only to observed; require a new-agent, new-page-instance verification before claiming cross-agent confirmation
Keep counterexamples and mark the affected rule unverified or narrowed
prohibitedPersistence: Credentials, tokens, account-wide inventory, balances, prices
Exact current tab, document, snapshot, element, request, or installation identifiers
Claims inferred from an absent field or incomplete page traversal
